sentence: The monthly account fee shows on the statement as MONTHLY A/C FEE. Book it to bank fees; it is never more than $10.
Anything with the payee MONTHLY A/C FEE is a bank fee, at most 12.50.
Our bank pays us interest as CREDIT INTEREST. Put it under interest, it's always under $3.
CREDIT INTEREST lines are interest income.
The card terminal company takes its cut as MERCHANT SERVICE FEE, up to $80. That's a merchant fee.

Dishonour fees come through as DISHONOUR FEE and cost $15 at most. Bank fee.
